svg.title: Life, versioned
svg.desc: A Git-style life graph. Career, garage, photography and club branches split from a shared life spine. Dated milestones sit on their own branches, which merge back together at now. Small right-hand illustrations show a mining turtle, a checked certificate, a first photograph and a puzzled fly in a classroom. The fly is a playful metaphor, not a learning result. Life, versioned. One life. A few branches. life career garage photo club 2014 · Minecraft + Lua Mining turtles on my own server. 2016 · Started at Novartis Betriebsinformatiker apprenticeship. 2019 · KTM Duke 390 The garage started on two wheels. 2020 · Earned the EFZ Four years of IT foundations. 2021 · Into full-stack PHP, Vue and business applications. 2022 · Founded Jogge di Balla Co-founder and vice president. 2023 · First camera Sony α7 IV. 2023 · Audi TT RS A new chapter on four wheels. 2024 · The S5 project Audi S5 B8.5. 2024 · Costa Rica, solo Wildlife through the lens. 2025 · APIs + data sync Interfaces and integrations. 2025 · The ICE, St. Moritz Cars, winter light and Koenigsegg. 2026 · Club platform live Service, kitchen and bar connected. 2026 · Published AI toolkit Reusable skills and specialist agents. 2026 · Trying to teach a fly Connectome experiments. Learning still pending. now · Still in development Code, cameras, cars and club life.

g.aria-label: Mining turtles on my own server.

svg.title: One block. A little Lua.
svg.desc: A small voxel mining robot with a terminal and pickaxe advances two short grid cells, mines one block, and returns. Its trail resolves into a pair of code braces before a long rest. Reduced motion shows the robot, block and route without movement.

g.aria-label: The garage started on two wheels.

svg.title: Qualification completed
svg.desc: A small certificate receives a handwritten check mark, then rests. With reduced motion, the completed check remains visible.

svg.title: The first frame
svg.desc: A small camera focuses, closes its shutter briefly and reveals a picture. It rests between captures. Reduced motion shows the camera and developed frame.

g.aria-label: A new chapter on four wheels.

svg.title: Learning still pending
svg.desc: A playful classroom illustration: chalk writes a simple lesson, a fly at a desk tilts its head and a question mark appears. It does not represent a simulation result or successful learning.

g.aria-label: Code, cameras, cars and club life.
